textRuns.value: All four columns deploy the same $250,000 (settings: available_capital). Rule: ACCEPT if the shifted return >= 5.00% hurdle, MAYBE within 1.00pt below, REJECT under 4.00%. Parallel shift is a teaching simplification - the same bp move is applied to every rate-linked option; FIXED-rate debt would keep its 17,500 saving regardless of market moves (the debt column's sensitivity describes variable-rate debt).
